This appeal has been filed against the impugned judgment dated 10.11.2023, passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Lakhimpur at North Lakhimpur, in Sessions Case No. 73(NL)/2022, by which the appellant has been convicted under Section 498A, 323, 457 and 326(A) of the IPC.
